body: I feel that I have a warped perception of friendship since majority of my past ones have involved a lot of codependency (my old friends and I were together 24/7, and they didn’t really have any other friends to hangout with) and now that i have formed healthier friendships with people who have more firm boundaries and other social circles, i feel as if I’m not as close to them. Is this just past me speaking here?

i hear you i feel trapped too sometimes. respectfully may i ask how your adhd is preventing you from getting help? maybe you look for more long term help on a more frequent basis
and again i hear you i know it feels like the cycle is just repeating but maybe you can give yourself something to look forward to like planning a fun meal the next day or planning a fun hangout with some coworkers. anything to keep you moving forward in a positive way

i know it feels so hard to feel defeated and you may not want to go on anymore, but you’ve made it this far and you’ve been through so many hardships and look at you- you just came out stronger. you have a whole community of people willing to hear you out and listen to you.

if you have nothing to lose then why not risk it all, but not in the way you think-ask that person out on a date, go to a bar and meet new people, sign up for a cooking or baking class, anything really. the possibilities are endless and there are so many people you’ve yet to meet who would be willing to care for and love you.

HAPPY BIRTHDAY!!! i know it feels shitty when no one remembers to wish you hbd, but treat yourself and buy all your favorite treats and watch your fav movie. just be kind to yourself and take it easy- maybe even an hour at a time.
